headline: Millwall's fifth keeper and Portsmouth's absences leave no clear favourite
summary: Portsmouth and Millwall meet at Fratton Park on Saturday level on 15 points, with identical mid-table records. Millwall are set to make a fifth goalkeeper change of the season after Filip Marschall damaged ankle ligaments against Lincoln, as Southwark News reported. Portsmouth are missing at least 10 players. Millwall create the better chances, averaging 1.68 expected goals a game, and have had 7 days to prepare while Portsmouth played on Tuesday. Even so, the market makes Portsmouth narrow favourites — 36.1% to Millwall's 35.7%. Over 2.5 goals is only 48.1%.
read: Two sides level on 15 points meet at Fratton Park and the market cannot split them: Portsmouth are 36.1% to Millwall's 35.7%. Portsmouth have lost once in seven but are down to at least 10 absentees, while Millwall's goalkeeper problems continue with a fifth change of the season and Arconte doubtful up front.

facts.fact: Portsmouth and Millwall are level on 15 points after 11 Championship games, 13th and 12th respectively.
facts.meaning: Saturday's lunchtime game is a straight mid-table shootout between two identical records.

facts.fact: Portsmouth are rated 36.1% to win, with Millwall right behind on 35.7%.
facts.meaning: Home advantage is worth almost nothing here — this is as close to a coin flip as a match gets.

facts.fact: Portsmouth are missing at least 10 players, with John Mousinho saying he hopes to have bodies back for the Millwall game.
facts.meaning: The squad is stretched thin going into a quick turnaround of fixtures.

facts.fact: Portsmouth have lost just one of their last seven Championship matches.
facts.meaning: Mousinho's side arrive hard to beat rather than spectacular — five of those seven were draws or wins by a single goal or fewer.

facts.fact: Millwall are averaging 1.68 xG per game over their last five, above Portsmouth's 1.36.
facts.meaning: The visitors are creating better chances than their 12th place and seven goals suggest.

facts.fact: Millwall are set to make their fifth goalkeeper change of the season after Filip Marschall was ruled out with ankle ligament damage suffered against Lincoln.
facts.meaning: A settled defence is impossible when the man behind it keeps changing.

facts.fact: Mousinho rested Marlon Pack, Zak Swanson, Ryan Kavuma-McQueen and Marko Milovanovic at Wolves, targeting the Millwall game as the more realistic proposition.
facts.meaning: Four regulars should arrive fresher than they otherwise would have.

facts.fact: Millwall forward T. Arconte, who has played 638 minutes and scored three goals this season, is listed as doubtful with an ankle injury.
facts.meaning: Alex Neil may be without his most-used attacker, on top of J. Coburn's muscle injury absence.

sources.fact: Portsmouth are missing at least 10 players through injury and boss John Mousinho said they are hoping to have bodies back for Millwall.
Portsmouth drew 1-1 at Wolves with a late Terry Devlin equaliser and have lost just one of their last seven Championship matches.
Mousinho rested Marlon Pack, Zak Swanson, Ryan Kavuma-McQueen and Marko Milovanovic at Wolves, targeting the Millwall game as the more realistic proposition.
Thomas Waddingham could return for Portsmouth against Millwall after being unavailable for the Wolves fixture.
Mousinho gave a pre-Millwall interview on Wednesday, October 21st.
Millwall goalkeeper Filip Marschall faces an extended spell out with ankle ligament damage suffered against Lincoln City.
Millwall are set to make their fifth goalkeeper change of the season for the Portsmouth trip.
Alex Neil confirmed an extended absence for a summer signing in another injury blow for Millwall.
